title: Iss Jaanwar Ke Paas Hai Sabse Ghani Fur! 🦦 #shorts
idea: Explaining how sea otters have the densest fur on Earth along with other insane physical facts

lines.text: Duniya mein sabse ghani fur wala jaanwar kaun sa hai?
Sea otter ke 1 square centimeter skin pe 150,000 baal hote hain!
Ye roz apne wazan ka 38 percent khana khate hain!
Paani mein 2,000 otters ek saath floating raft banate hain!
Ye paani ke andar 5 minute tak saans rok sakte hain!
Kya aapko pata tha ki otters rocks ko tool jaise use karte hain?

youtube.title: Iss Jaanwar Ke Paas Hai Sabse Ghani Fur! 🦦 #shorts
youtube.description:
Jaaniye Sea Otter ke baare mein mind-blowing facts! Kise pata tha ki inke 1 cm² skin pe 150,000 baal hote hain?

#seaotter #animalfacts #facts #hinglish #shorts

facts.claim: Sea otter's fur is the densest of any animal with up to 150,000 strands per square cm.
Sea otters must eat up to 38% of their body weight in food each day.
The largest sea otter raft ever seen had over 2,000 otters.
Sea otters can hold their breath underwater for up to 5 minutes.
